name: UPLOAD
summary: An approach searching for low-mass dark matter through axion mixing and frequency modulation between pumped microwave modes.
detection_principle: Axion–photon coupling upconverts low-frequency axion effects between driven microwave modes, read out as phase or amplitude noise.

status.label: Prototype experiments / R&D
status.evidence: 2019 sources support the phase recorded here, rather than a real-time status of the entire project as of the access date.

timeline.event: UPconversion Loop Oscillator Axion Detection experiment: A precision frequency interferometric axion dark matter search with a Cylindrical Microwave Cavity

collaboration.name: UPLOAD Collaboration / project team
collaboration.participants_note: Only documented principal institutions are listed; full author and affiliation lists are in the sources. Collaborating-institution addresses are not substituted for detector locations.

key_parameters.name: First study
key_parameters.value: Room-temperature tabletop dual-mode cavity; 2.5 h measurement

results.summary: Early papers report methods and pilot constraints; the later superconducting helical-cavity approach remains a design with sensitivity projections.

science_scope: Directly searches for Galactic-halo axions, axionlike particles or other ultralight dark matter. Limits depend on assumed local density, velocity distribution and coupling models; separate scanned mass intervals do not amount to exclusion of the entire range.
